<!-- pr-reviewer: d9f0902b18779012624c5793bec01963dfa4bac6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- One shared helper, `crates/ui/src/headless_gpu.rs`: `device()` tries the software adapter first (`force_fallback_adapter: true`), then the hardware one. Linux and Windows CI therefore keep the deterministic software adapter. The only remaining `force_fallback_adapter` in the tree is inside it (line 42).
- `device_for_test(suite)` prints the adapter it renders on. With no adapter it prints `*** <suite>: SKIPPED (no adapter) - NOT a pass ***`, and `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1` turns that into a failure. The three test files keep only thin wrappers around it, not copies of the logic.
- `headless::run` (shell.rs) uses the same helper, so the CLI path is fixed through the app itself. It logs `headless: <kind> adapter <name>`.
- No snapshot PNGs, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no build.rs/scripts/.github/dependency changes. The decision file `docs/decisions/615-gpu-adapter.md` is present. Module provenance line is present. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #615`.

**Local results, merged with upstream/main (clean merge, no conflicts), Apple Silicon Mac, Metal**

| Suite | Result | Adapter line seen |
|---|---|---|
| `gpu_render` | 9 passed, 0 skipped | rendering on the hardware adapter "Apple M5 Max" via Metal |
| `trace_composite` | 4 passed, 0 skipped | same |
| `trace_parity` | 5 passed, 0 skipped | same |
| `--lib headless_run_succeeds` | 1 passed | `headless: hardware adapter "Apple M5 Max" via Metal` |
| `--lib` (all) | 377 passed, 5 ignored | - |
| `--test shell` | 20 passed (includes `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`) | - |
| `--test egui_app` | 3 passed | - |
| `clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean | - |

All 18 GPU tests rendered; none skipped silently.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The SKIP and `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU` paths and the software-adapter-first order on Linux/Windows were read, not exercised (this Mac always finds Metal).
- `shell.rs` is 1624 lines, already far over the ~400-line guideline; this PR shrinks it slightly.
- The comment above `headless::run` (shell.rs, near line 1531) now runs past the usual wrap width. Cosmetic only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
